aboutText: Nu-GEN Electrical is a locally owned Melbourne business providing reliable, high-quality electrical services for homes and commercial spaces. The team brings years of hands-on experience, strong technical knowledge and a commitment to carrying out work that meets Australian safety standards every time. From new installations to upgrades and troubleshooting, every job is approached with care, precision and genuine professionalism.
